## Fixed

- **The panel kept saying a removed folder "was interrupted".** If a folder's
  backup was cut off and you then removed the folder, the panel went on showing
  "<folder> was interrupted" with a Carry on button that did nothing. Removing a
  folder now clears what its cut-off backup left behind, and the panel ignores
  any interrupted backup whose folder is gone. With no folders left, it goes back
  to "Add a folder to start".

- **Automatic backups stayed on with nothing to back up.** Removing your last
  folder now turns the schedule off, so it no longer runs for nothing. It stays
  on if you copy Drime folders to your S3 storage, since the schedule does that.
